title: Rundeck: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116585)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Rundeck package related to the Go JOSE library, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards. This affects versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.9. A fix is available in version 6.0.1-r11.
